mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO portfolio_realized_profit_loss ( order_execution_id, order_request_id, broker_order_no, account_no, stock_code, executed_quantity, average_buy_price, executed_price, buy_amount, sell_amount, realized_profit_loss, return_rate, realized_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{orderExecutionId}, #{orderRequestId}, #{brokerOrderNo}, #{accountNo}, #{stockCode}, #{executedQuantity}, #{averageBuyPrice}, #{executedPrice}, #{buyAmount}, #{sellAmount}, #{realizedProfitLoss}, #{returnRate}, #{realizedAt}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_execution_id, order_request_id, broker_order_no, account_no, stock_code, executed_quantity, average_buy_price, executed_price, buy_amount, sell_amount, realized_profit_loss, return_rate, realized_at, created_at FROM portfolio_realized_profit_loss WHERE order_execution_id = #{orderExecutionId} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, order_execution_id, order_request_id, broker_order_no, account_no, stock_code, executed_quantity, average_buy_price, executed_price, buy_amount, sell_amount, realized_profit_loss, return_rate, realized_at, created_at FROM portfolio_realized_profit_loss WHERE account_no = #{accountNo} AND broker_order_no LIKE 'PAPER-%' ORDER BY realized_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS sell_count, COALESCE(SUM(realized_profit_loss), 0) AS total_realized_profit_loss, AVG(return_rate) AS average_return_rate, COALESCE(SUM(sell_amount), 0) AS total_sell_amount FROM portfolio_realized_profit_loss WHERE account_no = #{accountNo} AND broker_order_no LIKE 'PAPER-%'
